question: If x - y + z = 0, then find the value of frac{{{y²}}}{{2xz}} - frac{{{x²}}}{{2yz}} - frac{{{z²}}}{{2xy}}
solution:
**Given:**

x - y + z = 0

**Calculation:**

Let, x =1; y = 2; and z = 1

So, x - y + z = 1 - 2 + 1 = 0 [Satisfied]

Then, (y²/2xz) - (x²/2yz) - (z²/2xy)

= (22/2 × 1 × 1) - (12/2 × 2 × 1) - (12/2 × 1 × 2)

= (4/2) - (1/4) - (1/4)

= 2 - 1/4 - 1/4

= 3/2

**∴ The value of the given expression is 3/2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**x - y + z = 0,

⇒ x + z = y

⇒ x³ + z³ + 3xyz = y³

⇒ 3xyz = y3 - x3 - z3 

frac{{{y²}}}{{2xz}} - frac{{{x²}}}{{2yz}} - frac{{{z²}}}{{2xy}}

⇒ frac{{{y³}}}{{2xzy}} - frac{{{x³}}}{{2xyz}} - frac{{{z³}}}{{2xyz}}

⇒ (y³ - x³ - z³)/2xyz

⇒ 3xyz/2xyz = 3/2

∴ The value of the given expression is 3/2
